name: dsh-at-sider
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: adds an @ file reference button (@文件 / @file, @文件夹 / @folder), a modification-time column and a size column, sortable rows, width-adaptive columns, a whole-workspace quick filter, reveal-in-tree and one-click @ references from file previews, a runtime toggle back to the native tree, and full keyboard navigation, to the native right-sidebar file tree, by taking over the builtin `files` tab kind as an extension. The Host half serves each directory's entries with mtimeMs over its own authenticated /api routes (the Harness's workspaceFiles listing carries no time); the Client half renders the tree with labelled @ chips that insert references into the composer (Alt-click copies the mention) and a pinned date column with a full local-time tooltip.
author: Chengrui Wang
